description: Canonical CBOR encoding (RFC 8949 §4.2.2 deterministic encoding) golden vectors. These vectors verify the encoder produces byte-stable output for the same logical input, enabling cross-implementation signature verification.
statusNote: draft — authored and verified against the reference TypeScript implementation (cborg with canonical: true). Cross-language ratification is PLANNED but NOT claimed until an independent consumer (Rust, Go, C) verifies these vectors.
inputFormatNote: Vectors use a JSON-friendly input format. Byte strings are represented as { '__bytes__': '<hex>' } because JSON cannot natively represent byte strings. Map keys in the input may be in any order; the canonical encoder MUST sort them.
verification: reference/encoding/golden-vectors.ts runCborGoldenVectors() asserts each vector at module load.
